input: My second monitor is still at Station Road. Do I need to bring it over myself?
Where can I park on my first day, and how do I get out of the building if there's a fire?
I only work Monday to Wednesday. Can I still work from home two days a week?
I start on 7 December. What do I need to bring and where do I go?
Is there somewhere safe to leave my bike?

output.reply:
Hi Ana, you don't need to carry your monitor. IT packs and moves every monitor, docking station and keyboard from Station Road to Riverside House [IT-01]. Because IT handles the move, there's nothing for Facilities to do here, and you don't need to tag, log or transport anything yourself.

The equipment is set up on the shared desks at Riverside House before Monday 7 December [IT-01]. The desks are shared, so your old monitor won't necessarily be at your zone B desk. That's fine: every desk has two monitors, and you don't need to track down the one you used before [IT-01].

If the desk you sit at is missing a monitor or something is broken, report it to it-help@example.com [IT-01].

Hi Chloe, here's what our help articles cover.

Parking: Riverside House has 4 accessible spaces next to the entrance for staff with a blue badge or a medical need. Email facilities@example.com to reserve one permanently. Other spaces are booked in the DeskBook app from Monday 30 November [FAC-01].

Fire evacuation: Facilities will make a personal evacuation plan with you. Ask before Monday 7 December at facilities@example.com. Evacuation chairs are kept at every stairwell, and trained fire wardens help people who have a plan [FAC-04].

Our articles don't cover the step-free route to Zone A, refuge points, or the named Zone A wardens. They also don't cover the assembly point, how lifts work during an alarm, or your team's general evacuation procedure. Please ask about these in the same email.

I can't contact you myself, so please email facilities@example.com to arrange both parking and your plan.

Hi Elif, the two-day allowance doesn't apply in full to you. Full-time staff can work from home up to 2 days a week, agreed with their manager [HR-01]. That rule hasn't changed with the move [HR-01]. Part-time staff can work from home for up to 40% of their working days each week, rounded down. For a three-day week (Monday to Wednesday), that means 1 day at home and 2 in the office [HR-03]. You also asked about required office days, such as team or anchor days. Our HR articles don't say whether any are set. They also don't say how such days apply to someone who doesn't work Thursday or Friday, so I can't confirm that part. Please check with your manager, who agrees home-working days [HR-01]. They should know whether any Marketing team or anchor days apply to you.

Hi Ben, here's what I can confirm for Monday 7 December. Arrive at reception at 09:00 and bring photo ID, which you'll use to collect your badge there. Your manager will meet you, and your laptop will be ready at your team's zone (zone C) [HR-02]. HR also sends a welcome email the week before [HR-02].

My articles don't say which building to go to that day. Both Station Road and Riverside House are mentioned in the move guidance [HR-04], but not which one applies on 7 December. Please check your welcome email or ask your manager. They also don't cover right-to-work documents, bank details or signed forms, so please confirm those directly with HR.

I can't contact other desks from here. For badge setup, ask Facilities, and for laptop setup, ask IT.

Hi Femi, yes, there's secure bike storage at the new office. It's covered, has room for 40 bikes, and sits behind the building, reached from Canal Street [FAC-02]. You open it with your access badge [FAC-02]. New badges are handed out at reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December, and you'll need to bring photo ID [FAC-03]. The same badge also opens the doors, lockers and printers [FAC-03].

My articles don't say whether bike spaces need booking. Car parking is booked in DeskBook [FAC-01], but nothing says that applies to bikes, so please check with Facilities before relying on it.

Showers and changing rooms are on the ground floor [FAC-02]. Lockers are on floor 2 and open with your badge, but you need to empty yours on Fridays [FAC-05]. Because you're hybrid, don't leave kit in a locker over the weekend.
